Bitecho Relay Ferry

Ferry opaque blobs between an offline light node and the HTTP Gateway Relay (/relay/v1/*). The node signs everything locally (shuttle.cjs or bitecho-light-node.cjs); this page only moves bytes. Nothing here holds a key. Poll/ack blobs are single-use and expire after 5 minutes — generate fresh, ferry immediately.

Multi-node note (measured 2026-11-12): the relay ring is per-node in-memory state and bitecho.org load-balances across ns1..ns3, so a poll that lands on another node than the send may return empty — click Poll again (each click may reach a different node). Opening this page at ns1.bitecho.org/relay.html pins send and poll to one node.

1. Send an envelope

Paste the envelope_hex from export-offer, export-accept or export-send. Check the character count and SHA-256 prefix match the node before clicking send.

3. Acknowledge received envelopes

Paste the ack_request JSON from import-poll (or export-ack). This prunes the relay inbox/broadcast ring so the same envelopes are not delivered twice.

4. Fetch Chain State

Query /relay/v1/chain-state to fetch validator-signed :chain-state-snapshot maps (when pubkey is provided) and the relay's min_signaling_burn / bootstrap metadata.
